firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently saw a bear, elk, salmon, hawk, or fox starts. The rulebook also allows choosing the starting player randomly.
officialTieBreak: No separate tie-break is stated; random selection is an official alternative.
clarifications: Choosing randomly is part of the printed setup, not an added house rule.
